_note: Structured from 'TTRPG Player Profiles.md'. Lines and Veils are held APART, unlike PlayerProfileManager.lines_and_veils which flattens both into one list — a Line is a prohibition, a Veil is 'handle off-screen', and SafetyGovernor cannot tell them apart once merged.

players.name: Elias
style_notes: prefers acting in-character, deep NPC relationships
will make suboptimal mechanical choices for narrative reasons
actively seeks inter-party roleplay in travel and downtime
veils: graphic torture (fade to black or off-screen)

players.name: Sarah
style_notes: complex grid combat, resource management, terrain use
political intrigue and untangling complex factions
challenging encounters requiring strategy to survive
optimizes to uplift the team, not to overshadow
lines: real-world bigotry (homophobia, transphobia, racism) directed at PCs or used as casual worldbuilding flavour

players.name: Marcus
style_notes: motivated by uncovering lore, finding secrets, exploring the map
takes decisive action during party analysis paralysis
enjoys high stakes; accepts character death if epic or meaningful
lines: animal cruelty or on-screen death of pets/familiars
veils: romance and sexual encounters (strict fade to black)
prolonged claustrophobia or being buried alive

players.name: Chloe
style_notes: enjoys listening and watching the story unfold
happy to take a backseat in intense roleplay
responds very well to direct prompts from GM or players

_derived.genre_problem: High Fantasy is the only genre three players share, and Marcus — the one most likely to drive the plot forward — does not list it. No genre is shared by all four.
union_lines: real-world bigotry directed at PCs or as casual worldbuilding flavour
animal cruelty or on-screen death of pets/familiars
union_veils: romance and sexual encounters involving PCs
